'''Waddledo''' is a [[Water]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Swaystroll]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "That poker face might fool some, but Waddledo has quite the temper. Walk along and keep those eyes to yourself."

Waddledo is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small crested penguin Tatari with blue, white, and yellow feathers. Its eyes are icy blue with dark blue pupils.

Waddledo's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its yellow crest feathers to purple.

== Evolution Trial ==
Waddledo's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Swaystroll]] you need to complete the following task:
* Feed Waddledo Shaved Ice x3.

== Trivia ==
* Original Bio:" Waddledo knows it has to beat up Zobos, or there will be no candy for it to eat when its older!"
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Waddledo knows beating up [[Zobos]] after growing up is the only way to survive in this harsh, competitive Tatari world."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Waddledo keeps a poker face most of the time, but loses it easily when provoked. Gotta work on that anger management."
